packageRules.description: A closed PR skips the version its title names. The default major title names only the major (`to v5`), so closing it would skip every later v5 release.
renovate runs through bunx in dependency-submission.yml and as a Docker image in renovate.yml; one group moves both pins in one PR until issue 98 leaves one pin.

customManagers.description: semantic-release, its exec plugin, and renovate run through bunx, outside package.json, so every line that names their versions is bumped here.

Renovate's Swift manager reads only Package.swift, and an Xcode project stores its resolved packages here. One match edits revision and version together; the name comes from the URL, so any GitHub-hosted package matches.
A major move fails `upToNextMajorVersion` unless minimumVersion moves with it. The same depName as in Package.resolved puts both edits in one PR.
